claims: SpaceX successfully launched 27 Starlink satellites via a Falcon 9 rocket from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California on April 6, 2026, at 7:49 p.m. PT.
7:49 p.m. PT on April 6, 2026 is 10:49 p.m. ET.
The first-stage booster of the Falcon 9 rocket used in the April 6, 2026 launch from Vandenberg Space Force Base landed on a droneship.
A Falcon 9 launched Starlink satellites from Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E) at Vandenberg on April 6, 2026.
A Falcon 9 mission launched 29 Starlink satellites from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida on April 2, 2026.
SpaceX launched the EchoStar XXV mission from SLC-40 at Cape Canaveral on March 10, 2026.
Falcon 9 is a two-stage rocket designed for the transport of satellites and the Dragon spacecraft.
The first-stage booster for recent missions typically lands on a droneship.
"A Shortfall of Gravitas" is a droneship in the Atlantic.
"Of Course I Still Love You" is a droneship in the Pacific.
Falcon 9 is primarily used for launching Starlink internet satellites as well as commercial, government, and international scientific missions.
